scope: Original-source VS Main/Rules/Items route with one item-row edit, frequency-selector save ordering, a three-stock Final Destination match, No Contest Results, retained Rules/CSS state, and Eject/reimport cleanup. Retail route observation and rendered-browser evidence are independent; no cross-runtime equivalence is claimed.

callbacks_and_transitions.main_to_vs: mn_8022DB10 handles SEL_MAIN_VS and changes the original menu kind to VS.
callbacks_and_transitions.vs_to_rules: mn_8022D594 handles SEL_VS_RULES and calls mn_80231714.
callbacks_and_transitions.rules: fn_8022F538 handles Rules navigation, B to VS focus, and Start to commit GameRules before GM_VS handoff.
callbacks_and_transitions.items: fn_80233E10 owns source A/B/Start and directional input; fn_80234C24 handles the entry/exit animation and confirmed item/frequency updates.
callbacks_and_transitions.item_frequency_save: The source selector invokes mnItemSw_SaveSettings, which copies authored item flags and stores frequency as x21 - 1.
callbacks_and_transitions.items_back: MenuInput_Back calls mnItemSw_CommitItems, lbCardGame_UpdatePowerTime, and mn_8023164C to return to Rules.

callbacks_and_transitions.css_to_main: mnCharSel_Scene_OnFrame uses the source PAD_LR_START parent route to GM_MENU.
callbacks_and_transitions.match_to_results: The source PAD_LR_START + A + Start sequence produces the original No Contest Results route.

source_authored_item_mask_mapping.browser_assertion: Both bit positions are asserted by the full-route browser harness against live source observations.

source_route.save_effect_boundary: Browser observations establish source GameRules/item preference state within the running session and its retention through Results/CSS. The route does not establish a card/GCI write or Personal-profile autosave for the edited item mask.

browser.browser: Headless installed Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 through Playwright; real HTTP served the Release browser package.
browser.input: Original source PAD callbacks through the B0XX keyboard mapping; no physical controller.
browser.save_mode: Everything unlocked, native runtime default in a fresh isolated Playwright context. No Personal profile was loaded and no user browser save was mutated.
route: Initial original CSS -> Main -> VS -> Rules -> Items.
Source A transiently toggles Items cursor 0. Source frequency controls move None -> Very High -> None; the original selector saves the pending row state before B returns to Rules.
Rules stock changes from 4 to 3; source Start commits the Rules and returns to CSS.
Source SSS geometry navigation selects Final Destination (St_Kind_Last, 0x20).
A live Mario vs Mario Stock match reaches 180+ source frames with three stocks, item frequency -1 (None), and the custom source item mask.
Source pause and PAD_LR_START + A + Start produce No Contest outcome 7 and original Results; original navigation returns to CSS, with Rules/item values retained on re-entry.
Eject tears down source owners, scoped assets, and audio banks; reimport returns to original CSS. A second Eject returns to idle import state.

claims.audio_equivalence: not_run; host output muted by policy while DSP/audio processing remained enabled

browser.rendered_observation: The Items and Results screens render in Chrome. The live Final Destination screenshot contains prominent magenta stage-outline artifacts; rendered capture is evidence of a real browser match route, not visual parity.

validation.browser_harness: node --check tests/vs_rules_item_menu_browser_test.mjs passed; browser route rerun passed with exact bit mapping assertions.
validation.overall_boundary: This is a rendered original-source route and source-state observation. It does not claim retail-to-browser equivalence, item spawning, source card persistence, pixel/PCM equivalence, physical input, or performance.
